newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Treasury to offer A$600 mln in T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: Australia Treasury to offer A$600 mln in T-bonds.

text.p: The Treasury will offer a total of A$600 million in Treasury bonds through a tender on Tuesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said.
The offering will comprise A$300 million of 7.0 percent bonds maturing in April 2000,and A$300 million of 10.0 percent bonds maturing in October 2007.
The bank said bids would be received until 12.45 pm. (0245 GMT) on Tuesday and results would announced at 2.00 p.m. (0400 GMT). Settlement date is April 10.
